# Third-party dependencies

Run `make deps` to fetch the exact pinned source revisions used by this project.
The fetched files are intentionally excluded from the source archive to avoid
silently modifying upstream license text and to keep updates auditable.

- MQTT-C, MIT License, commit `7a986a68ebea63921d4aab20a9d1b26a8b5f8c9d`
- picojson, BSD-2-Clause, commit `111c9be5188f7350c2eac9ddaedd8cca3d7bf394`
